SvelteKit serves an app under `paths.base` and checks route names in `resolve()` of `$app/paths`. A link or a `goto()` to a plain string like `"/settings"` skips both: it breaks when the app moves under a base path, and a typo in the route is not found.

Allowed are the calls of `resolve()` and `asset()` of `$app/paths`, a constant that holds one, both branches of a `? :` that are allowed, and with type information a value of the type `ResolvedPathname` of `$app/types` (`parserOptions.project` or `projectService` with `@typescript-eslint/parser` for the scripts of a component). An `href` may also be an absolute URL, a `#fragment`, `null` or `undefined`, or a link with `rel="external"`. `pushState()` and `replaceState()` may also be given `""`. It only runs in a project with SvelteKit 1, 2 or 3.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`. It uses types where the scripts of a component have `@typescript-eslint/parser` and a project:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";
import ts from "typescript-eslint";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  {
    files: ["**/*.svelte"],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: { parser: ts.parser, projectService: true, extraFileExtensions: [".svelte"] },
    },
    rules: { "svelte/no-navigation-without-resolve": "error" },
  },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"packages": {"@sveltejs/kit": "2.5.0"}} */}

```svelte
<script>
  import { goto } from "$app/navigation";
</script>

<a href="/settings">Settings</a>
<button onclick={() => goto("/settings")}>Settings</button>
```

Not reported:

{/* good {"packages": {"@sveltejs/kit": "2.5.0"}} */}

```svelte
<script>
  import { goto } from "$app/navigation";
  import { resolve } from "$app/paths";
</script>

<a href={resolve("/settings")}>Settings</a>
<button onclick={() => goto(resolve("/settings"))}>Settings</button>
```

## Options

| Option               | Default | What it does                             |
| -------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `ignoreGoto`         | `false` | Leaves out the calls of `goto()`         |
| `ignoreLinks`        | `false` | Leaves out the `href` of `<a>` elements  |
| `ignorePushState`    | `false` | Leaves out the calls of `pushState()`    |
| `ignoreReplaceState` | `false` | Leaves out the calls of `replaceState()` |
